reason: Confirmed on the ledger at 07:02:42Z. Probe 50 (56629533) was submitted at 05:02:30Z and is PENDING. Observed K2-family latency is (6.69, 7.81] h, and the exp85a dummy ran 1,388 s against exp70g's 1,409 s, so there is no runtime shift. That puts 50 terminal at ~12:27-12:51Z, and with the 10-min poll it shows in a header by ~12:37-13:01Z. W2b is fixed at 12:00Z (W2 v4 (2), 04:38Z amendment, 05:03Z line), so as written it is chosen blind to 50. Five 28 Sep submits are allowed and four are used (00:06, 00:06, 00:50, 05:02), so W2b and W3 are the same single slot, and W2 v4 (2)(v) already lets that slot move to W3 (<= 23:30Z). Delaying it costs no slot. The decision really does depend on 50: exp86a/b/c were built at 06:37Z as the 50-'+' branch files, and exp85b/c are near-duplicates (06:26Z). round24 PC24-01 found the same issue independently. Four corrections, none of which refutes the finding. (1) The CI latency of 9.7-10.5 h is an expectation (CONTEXT l.3278), not a measurement; 48 is still pending. The logged band is 9.4-10.9 h, and 12:00Z + 10.9 h = 22:54Z, still before the W4 start. (2) 'W4 lock 23:30Z' is not a registered term. W3 means submit <= 23:30Z, and W4 AMEND 2 needs dummies PASSED by 00:00Z. (3) 'Costs no information for W4' is slightly too strong. The non-CI W2b read moves from ~19:30-19:50Z to ~20:10-21:50Z, which leaves ~1.7-3.8 h for any W4 dummy that depends on it; pushing the branch dummies in advance covers this. (4) A CI file at 12:00Z still spends the only slot blind to 50. That is acceptable, because its purpose is a CI read before W4. The timing line does not by itself make exp86a/b/c legal (PC24-02); a separate pre-score row is needed.

realistic_gain: No direct score change; it only affects which file is chosen. It lets the single remaining 28 Sep slot go to a 50-conditioned file, e.g. exp86a/b if 50 reads '+' or the other-direction arm if 50 reads '-', instead of a blind pick. That gives one more informative public read before W4 and the 29 Sep finals proposal. Expected public effect about +0.000-0.001 through better file choice (P ~0.2-0.3 that the chosen file differs and displays higher). Private effect unknown. Cost about 0: no slot is lost, and the W4 prep window shrinks by ~1-2 h.
